name: prims_ts_decode_wrapper_tuple_encoded_page4_multi_q_sq4_h32_kv4_d128_ps32_sps4
description: Reusable PrimTS GQA decode wrapper. The dense block table, sequence lengths, Q offsets, mask, window, and static bounds are retained by plan(); run() receives only Q, the HND cache, scales, and an optional output buffer. The plan uses encoded semantic page-4 locators over larger physical cache pages.

storage_page_size.description: Physical token extent of each KV-cache page.

len_qo_indptr.description: Length of plan-owned cumulative Q offsets.

page_size.description: Semantic block-table page size for encoded subpage locators.

qo_indptr.description: Cumulative Q offsets retained by plan().

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
